facts.fact: 警察上门查守夜失窃画像与奔驰车胎上的尿；Seb 血誓掌心发痒想起 Johnny 的滑动镜——一眨眼把 Blue 画像藏进暗门。
facts.anchor: When my blood oath palm began to itch, I remembered Johnny’s sliding mirror

facts.fact: Seb 躲回房间假读书，差点被抓包——书拿倒了，及时翻正。
facts.anchor: I fixed it just in time.

facts.fact: 家族会议 Finn 摊牌 Johnny 的身世——死亡机车俱乐部的会长之子；Dale 恍然：「他听到摩托声总是跳起来」。
facts.anchor: Because he is the son of the president of a deadly biker club.

facts.fact: Finn 回答「牧师是 Blue 的什么人」：她的父亲——Dale 与 Harmony 哑口无言，桌边炸锅。
facts.anchor: Finn squinted. His neck strained. Then he growled, “Her father.”

facts.fact: Harmony 母熊爆发：不许取人性命、做你那个美丽的灵魂——Seb 当场撒谎答应。
facts.anchor: Don’t take a life. Don’t be like that bastard of a man.

facts.fact: Harmony 立第二条规矩：家中出事（机车帮相关）不许救父母，躲进 Finn 的房间拉上镜子——「你们不躲起来会害死我们」。
facts.anchor: You not hiding away will literally get us killed.

facts.fact: 书名三现：牧师自认先知、门徒信以为真——当有人坚信自己正义，其捍卫行动可以致命；牧师与 Seb 同拴于可怕的风暴。
facts.anchor: That made both the pastor and me anchored to our horrific storm.

facts.fact: 被尿过的奔驰两次驶过、牧师对 Seb 微笑——他恨 Seb 教会了 Blue 说「不」，正是这个「不」害死了她。
facts.anchor: I, without knowing it, had been a part of teaching Blue to say… no.

facts.fact: 凉亭外 Finn 一边运球一边揭晓：这不是第一次了——「所以我才买了枪」。
facts.anchor: He watched the ball as he dribbled it back up the driveway. Making a shot, he said, “That’s why I got a gun.”
